:::{#def-flexibility}
#### Flexibility

Let $g_1$ and $g_2$ be [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure)
that each choose, by least squares,
a [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) from a set of candidate functions,
$\mathcal{G}_1$ and $\mathcal{G}_2$ respectively.
The procedure $g_2$ is **at least as flexible** as $g_1$
if every candidate of $g_1$ is also a candidate of $g_2$:

$$
\mathcal{G}_1 \subseteq \mathcal{G}_2.
$$ {#eq-flexibility}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 2.1.3] use flexibility without a formal definition.
The nested form given here is a narrower one,
chosen so that the procedures on this page are exactly ordered.
:::

:::
